title: The summary for Saturday 28 November
text:
Good morning, it is Saturday 28 November: this is the GERICO summary.

Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani says that the drone that killed two Italian technicians in Kuwait on Thursday is Iranian-made, according to the Kuwaiti investigation. Tehran denies launching it from its territory and offers to join a commission of inquiry.

Zelensky told Prime Minister Meloni that the Ukrainian attack on the Russian ship Merkury, in the Libyan port of Benghazi, had not been agreed with European partners. Palazzo Chigi speaks of grievances raised by Rome.

Costa Rica has denied entry to Francesca Albanese, UN Special Rapporteur on the Palestinian territories. The UN asks for the decision to be reviewed, while Israel praises it.

Today Taiwan votes for mayors and county heads. In Taipei the contest is closely followed, and Beijing has sent warplanes.

Moving on to the markets. On Friday, Wall Street closed sharply higher in a shortened session: the Nasdaq rose by more than two points, the S&P 500 by one and a half. Tech stocks provided a boost, and Anthropic closed above its flotation price.

In Europe, Piazza Affari gained almost two points, led by banks and defence. The spread between BTPs and Bunds fell to 104 points. Brent remained around 94 dollars.

Today the markets are closed and the data calendar is empty.

The full stories, with sources, are on GERICO. No investment advice.
